# Purpose
This file is a unit test program for the `fd_active_set` code. It checks the stake-to-bucket mapping in `fd_active_set_stake_bucket`, verifies the required alignment with `FD_STATIC_ASSERT`, and tests active set creation and rotation with a test CRDS data set. It also calls `fd_active_set_nodes` with random identity and target values to exercise node selection logic. The [`main`](<#main>) function starts the runtime, runs the tests, and prints `pass` when all checks succeed.
